cohort: The study included 300 women with new-onset hypertensive disorders of pregnancy after the 20th week of gestation from a regional hospital in Durban, South Africa.
finding: HIV or its treatment appears to have a protective effect against the development of HDP, though it may be associated with significant maternal complications like abruption and elevated liver enzymes among women living with HIV.
gest_age: Pregnancies after the 20th week of gestation
